description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6130015526350 INVERTER,POWER,STAT: Line 0001 Qty 96 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0127 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
